# Pediatric careers release — October 18, 2026

Approved for production following review of PR #47 and its Wix preview.

Release the shared company introduction across the SLP, OT, PT, and Clinical Director job descriptions, the updated Clinical Director criteria and responsibilities, and the redesigned careers overview and four full role pages.

SLP, OT, and PT remain 1099 contractor opportunities. The Clinical Director accepts Arkansas-licensed OT, PT, or SLP applicants, requires five years of relevant pediatric clinical experience and demonstrated multidisciplinary leadership, and prefers two or more years of leadership experience.

Pre-release validation: all seven PR workflows passed, including the actual Wix account/runtime preview build and six careers checks. Desktop layout, leadership filtering, and the Clinical Director page were reviewed in the hosted preview.

The existing Deploy web workflow publishes the linked faithreins.com Wix site. Verify the careers overview and all four role pages after release, alongside the existing production navigation, account, and metadata checks.
